command: set -eu; echo '=== CURRENT_RELEASE ==='; cat /workspace/omega_runtime/CURRENT_RELEASE.json 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== CARRIER HEAD ==='; git -C /workspace/omega_runtime/carrier_repo rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true; git -C /workspace/omega_runtime/carrier_repo branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== DEPLOY/ACTIVATE REFERENCES ==='; grep -RIl --exclude-dir=.git -E 'CURRENT_RELEASE|omega_deploy|releases/' /workspace/omega_runtime/carrier_repo /workspace/omega_runtime 2>/dev/null | head -80 || true; echo '=== RELEASE DIRECTORIES ==='; find /workspace/omega_runtime/releases -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 2 -type d -print 2>/dev/null | tail -40 || true
